text:
elaine_docs: quick sync — PR #4123 (migration guide: private deployment networking) is ready for review. I fixed the examples and added the mkdocs snippet but Netlify preview is 404ing one of the generated asset hashes on the deploy preview. I need a reviewer and a merge slot tonight (we're targeting 22:00 UTC). link: https://app.netlify.com/sites/redwood-docs/deploys/preview-4123 :hourglass_flowing_sand:

ci-bot: Netlify build failed: 1 asset 404 (/_static/js/migration-3a7f2.js). Full log: https://netlify-logs.example/4123

josh_platform: looking now — can you paste the mkdocs base_url and the netlify.toml section you used? :eyes:

elaine_docs: sure, mkdocs.yml has "site_url: \"https://docs.redwood.ai\"" and I added a redirect rule in netlify.toml: `[[redirects]]\n  from = "/migration/*"\n  to = "/migration/"\n  status = 200`

sam_eng: one quick thought — the preview artifact path on Netlify sometimes strips the leading slash when we link with absolute paths. try changing the asset link to relative in the template (e.g., `href="{{ base_url }}/assets/..."` -> `href="assets/..."`) and see if the preview serves it.

elaine_docs: good call. I changed the link in the template to relative and pushed a small fix — CI triggered again: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4123/checks

netlify-bot: Deploy started for branch docs/pr-4123-preview (preview-4123).

ci-bot: Deploy failed (same 404) — looks like the site generator is emitting the asset with a hashed filename but some references still point to the unhashed path. Suggest running `mkdocs build` locally and inspect /site/_static/js to confirm filenames.

josh_platform: I'll pick this up. ETA ~30m. If I can't make the preview green, we can still merge into the staging slot if we're confident, but we should avoid breaking the preview link used by the product docs checklist.

elaine_docs: preference is to keep preview green — a couple of PMs will eyeball the migration guide tomorrow. If you need a merge slot, we can do a late merge but want to avoid a doc rollback.

sam_eng: local repro instructions for anyone else trying to debug:
```
git fetch origin pull/4123/head:pr-4123
git checkout pr-4123
pip install -r requirements.txt
mkdocs build --clean
python -m http.server --directory site 8000
# then open http://localhost:8000/migration/index.html
```

elaine_docs: thx. tagging the reviewers: @josh_platform and @sam_eng. Also added a short note in the PR description on what to check (asset manifest, absolute vs relative links).

josh_platform: quick update — found a template include that still used `{{ site_url }}/_static/...` (hardcoded). Pushed fix and re-triggered Netlify. Link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/commits/pr-4123

netlify-bot: Deploy succeeded for preview-4123 — available at https://deploy-preview-4123--redwood-docs.netlify.app :tada:

elaine_docs: awesome :raised_hands: — can one of you approve so I can merge into the scheduled window? We want the change to land before the release tomorrow morning.

josh_platform: approved. leaving a short PR review now. Will merge at 22:00 UTC if no blockers.

sam_eng: reviewed + minor nit (typo in code block), not blocking.

elaine_docs: thank you! I'll hold merge permission until 21:55 and queue the merge at 22:00 UTC. If anything flakey comes up, I'll ping here and we can postpone.

ci-bot: Note: after merge, the production deploy job will run. If you need to abort, comment `ci-bot: abort deploy` within the next 10 minutes after merge.

elaine_docs: noted. final check: anyone else want to quick sanity-check the migration example? otherwise I'll merge at the slot. :pray:
